name: Upward Flatpoint
description: Release the star flat from a thumb and forefinger pinch with a short straight arm snap at the target.

name: Square Peppering
description: Bring the star back beside the ear and snap the wrist forward so it flies level at the chest.

name: Gnawing Scatter
description: A star held flat in the fist shows one point that jabs into a grabbing hand or soft belly.

name: Spokelid
description: Turn the blunt flat of the star against an incoming wrist or blade edge to nudge it off line.

name: Whizhop
description: Slide the rear foot a quarter turn so the throwing shoulder squares to the target before release.

name: Tippoint Gauge
description: Hold a slow low breath and fix both eyes on one spot of the target to judge its distance.

name: Toothbump
description: Slip a star out of a sash fold with two fingers and throw it before the target settles.

name: Thinplate Drop
description: Rest the star in a cupped palm and flick it sideways off the fingertips at hip height.

name: Edgeface Dash
description: The fist closes around the star so one spoke pokes out and punches into a soft target.

name: Toothlid
description: Cross two held stars before the face so a swung club or kick lands on the flats instead.

name: Locking Whiz
description: Drive the heel of the free hand into a grabbing arm to break the hold before throwing.

name: Level Bladeface
description: Throw two stars one after another while stepping backward so a rushing attacker must slow down to dodge.

name: Whizskitter
description: After a throw the back foot slides one pace behind the front to restore balance and guard.

name: Low Hub
description: Extend the whole arm toward the mark and open the fingers so the star skims flat and level.

name: Short Cornerpoint
description: Swing the hand upward from the thigh and lob the star at a target crouched behind low cover.

name: Hailstrike
description: Drag a star point across the knuckles of a hand gripping a weapon to make it loosen.

name: Angled Centerhole
description: Tuck both elbows against the ribs and raise the forearms to take a blow away from the body.

name: Measured Spoke
description: Root both feet and keep the throwing hand raised and still while the eyes settle on the mark.

name: Firm Spoke
description: Pull a star from a coat pocket in one motion and send it flying before the hand stops moving.

name: Hailblow
description: From a seated position flick the star out sideways using only the wrist and a twist of the waist.

name: Spokehit
description: Whip the back of the fist outward so the star in it rakes a thin line across the cheek.

name: Forward Hail
description: Press the shoulder to a wall and fling the star past the corner at someone approaching.

name: Tight Rimpoint
description: Let a thick cuff catch an incoming cut and turn the wrist so the blade slides away.

name: Swaying Thinplate
description: Drop the knees and tuck the head so a wide swing passes overhead and the thrower stays close.

name: Hitching Spray
description: Press a thumb toward the opponent's eyes to make them flinch and miss their own strike.

name: Hard Rimpoint
description: Throw star after star on a steady spoken count so that the target never has a quiet moment to advance.

name: Hailbump
description: Hold the star edge-on and throw it stiffly so a single point leads and strikes first.

name: Firm Edgeface
description: Lock the wrist and push the star out flat so it skims low across open ground.

name: Wide Hub
description: Pinch two neighbouring spokes and draw the other points across an exposed forearm in one pull.

name: Sprayamble
description: Tip the upper body back from the hips so a cut passes a hand width from the chest.

name: Spokehusk
description: Roll the forearm outward across an incoming strike so it glances away along the muscle.

name: Hubhit
description: Loose three stars on a fixed beat while walking forward to drive the target back a pace each time.

name: Firm Whiz
description: A trace of qi in the fingertips sets the star spinning faster as it leaves the hand.

name: Sharp Spray
description: Whip the wrist across the body and let go late so the star turns many times before it lands.

name: Flat Flatpoint
description: Aim the spinning star to pass level with the throat so the target must duck or lean.

name: Square Cornerpoint
description: Pass a thread of qi into a held star and slash a spoke across the target's open hand.

name: Resting Tippoint
description: Slap a spinning star out of the air with a qi-padded palm so its turning dies in the touch.

name: Stepping Sprinkle
description: Step low to the side while releasing so the throw leaves from an angle the foe did not watch.

name: Soft Centerhole
description: Feel the air against the wet fingertip and a thin pulse of qi to judge how far a star will drift.

name: Toothdash
description: At close range throw hard and flat at the middle of the chest before the target can react.

name: Short Peppering
description: Throw the star up and out in a high arc so it drops onto a distant target from above.

name: Hubcount
description: Count paces to the target while breathing evenly and keep a steady qi sense of the gap.

name: Straight Sprinkle
description: Slice the outer edge of the star across the palm of an opponent reaching to seize it.

name: Tippoint Cowl
description: Step backward while turning a shoulder and a qi-hardened forearm toward the blow to blunt it.

name: Descending Spoke
description: A hidden star drops from the cuff into the fingers and is flicked out in the same breath.

name: Whizbump
description: Let the arm hang loose then swing it up so the star leaves the cuff low and unseen.

name: Low Scatter
description: Slide a star from the sleeve into the palm and rake it across the cheek of a close foe.

name: Resting Bladeface
description: Wind the thick sleeve around the forearm and take a cut on it while qi toughens the cloth.

name: Peppering Husk
description: Yank the wrist back through the cuff so a seizing hand closes on empty cloth.

name: Hailtrot
description: Walk with an even loose stride that keeps the hidden stars silent and the arms natural.

name: Short Rimpoint
description: Fling three stars from the cuff in a quick fan so the whole line of approach is covered.

name: Sideways Cornerpoint
description: Drop the shoulder and roll backward over it to rise a body length away from the attacker.

name: Sprinkle Strike
description: Hook a spoke of the held star around the arm and drag it back in a short slash.

name: Forward Edgeface
description: Drive one point of the held star forward with a qi-hardened thrust into a gap in guard.

name: Whizhusk
description: Catch a spoke against the crossguard of a blade and twist so the sword cannot be drawn free.

name: Planted Hub
description: Brace the wrist and turn the star flat to slide a downward cut away from the body.

name: Open Whiz
description: Hop backward from a close fight and release a star as the feet touch down again.

name: Bladeface Gauge
description: Breathe into the lower belly and let qi settle the stance before reading the opponent's shoulders.

name: Descending Flatpoint
description: The four-pointed star is thrown flat and fast and skims in a short direct line.

name: Sprayblow
description: Hurl the heavier six-pointed star with a full arm swing so it bites deeper on landing.

name: Short Thinplate
description: A fast wrist spin on the eight-pointed star makes it shear through cloth at the edge of reach.

name: Spraystrike
description: Rake several points at once across the forearm of an opponent who grabs for the star.

name: Straight Tippoint
description: Stab a single spoke tip into the soft hollow of an elbow or knee joint.

name: Resting Hub
description: Catch an incoming blade between two spokes and wrench it aside before it can reach the body.

name: Whizdash
description: Throw a light star then a heavy one a heartbeat later so the dodge to the first meets the second.
